_comment: Where each quotation of the Wordplay thread's round 2 structures (Boys, Jebb, Forbes, with Bullinger) and of the new cites on five live structures was read, word for word. For the scans (Lowth, Jebb, Boys, Forbes) found_in is archive.org's page text of the leaf the words are on (BookReaderGetTextWrapper, page = leaf index), as a checking reader fetched it on the day in retrieved; also_in is the next leaf when a quotation runs over the page. Each part of a quotation was matched against that text: exact, or letters (the OCR's long s and a few misread letters, never a missing word), or runs (every word inside a run of four or more that a fetch of that scan returned). context is the page text around the first part, lowercased with punctuation dropped, OCR spelling kept. Bullinger's Figures of Speech (1898) was read in the UniqueBible.app module at github.com/darrelwright/UniqueBible_Books, commit 4017a67481e0de6027216bbdf3fc5d42c9c289d5.
